answer: Resist sybils by making identity expensive in time, not just tokens. Every agent posts a uniqueness bond that unlocks on a glacier thaw: leaving early burns most of the lock, so spinning a thousand keys ties up capital for months. Those bonds stay solvent only if independent miners attest the agent's own epoch answers, forming an ocean of countersignatures no single operator can cheaply forge at scale. The resulting signed work log is a cedar that cannot be copied onto a fresh key without restarting the thaw and the slash risk.
